name: Richard Glover
biography: Richard is our Senior Minister (Rector), leading and overseeing the mission of St John’s. He loves helping people see how the person of Jesus sheds light on our most mundane and our most complicated life issues, and believes that such issues are best discussed over a a table, with a coffee and laughter.

Richard grew up on the South Coast of NSW and then spent the last twenty years living in Sydney’s Inner West before moving to Darlinghurst. He has degrees in history, political economy, and theology. He’s married to Alison, and they have four school-aged kids.
